# Disagreement Log — GTH_106

**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 106 | "sons of man" | "sons of man" | "children of humanity" | *shēre mrōme*: messianic title vs. generic humanity |
| 2 | 106 | "Mountain, move away!" | "Mountain, be moved!" | "tell a mountain to move" | Mountain command: active imperative vs. passive vs. narrative |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "sons of man" (preserves ambiguity between messianic title and generic humanity) and "Mountain, move away!" (active imperative, preserving the direct address).
